## Specification

### Component: Radio group

Choose one option from a visible set. Native radios share one `name`, so arrow keys, the roving tab stop, form submission and screen-reader semantics are the browser's. A "card" variant adds a selection ring that glides between cards.

#### Anatomy
```
<RadioGroup>        <div role="radiogroup" class="ui-radio-group [ui-radio-group-sm|-lg]" data-orientation data-variant>
  <RadioGroupItem>  <label class="ui-radio [ui-radio-card]" data-state="checked|unchecked" data-disabled>
                      <span class="ui-radio-control">
                        <input type="radio" class="ui-radio-input" name value>   invisible, covers the circle
                        <span class="ui-radio-circle" aria-hidden><span class="ui-radio-dot"></span></span>
                      </span>
                      <span class="ui-radio-text"><span class="ui-radio-label"> <span class="ui-radio-description" id>
  (card variant)    <span class="ui-radio-ring" aria-hidden>  last child of the group
```
- A context carries `name`, `value`, `setValue`, `disabled`, `required`, `invalid`, `variant` to the items. An item outside a group throws.

#### Props
- `RadioGroup`: `value` / `defaultValue` / `onValueChange(value)` (controlled or uncontrolled), `name` (generated with `useId` if omitted), `orientation` `vertical` (default) · `horizontal`, `variant` `default` · `card`, `size` `sm` 16 · `md` 20 · `lg` 24, `disabled`, `required`, `invalid`, plus div props (`aria-label`, `className`).
- `RadioGroupItem`: `value` (required), `label`, `description`, `disabled`, plus input props; `ref` goes to the input, `className` to the label.

#### Visual rules
- Circle: 1px `--ui-border-strong`, `--ui-surface`, `--ui-shadow-xs`. Checked: `--ui-control-on` fill/border and a dot (40% of the circle) in `--ui-control-glyph`.
- Vertical: grid gap 12px. Horizontal: flex wrap, gap 12px 24px. Label 14px/500, description 13px muted.
- Disabled item: circle + text opacity .5, `cursor: not-allowed`. Invalid: `--ui-destructive` border/fill.
- Cards: padding 14px 16px, 1px `--ui-border`, `--radius-lg`, gap 8px vertical; horizontal = grid `repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 11rem), 1fr))`. Checked card background is `--ui-control-on` 6% over `--ui-surface`.
- Ring: 1px `--ui-control-on` border + inset 1px ring, `--radius-lg`, `pointer-events: none`, absolutely positioned in the (relative) group.

#### Behaviour (ring)
- In a layout effect the checked card is measured (`offsetLeft/Top/Width/Height`) and the ring gets `transform: translate(x, y)`, `width`, `height`; no checked card → opacity 0.
- The group gets `data-glide` one frame after the first placement; only then do the ring transitions apply. A `ResizeObserver` removes `data-glide`, re-places the ring and restores it, so resizing never makes it swim. Before `data-glide` the checked card draws its own ring (SSR / first paint).

#### Motion
- Dot: `scale(0 → 1)` on `--ui-spring-snappy`; press scales the circle to .92.
- Ring: `transform`, `width`, `height` on `--ui-spring-morph` (550ms); opacity 150ms.
- Reduced motion: the ring jumps; colours still change.

#### Accessibility
- WAI-ARIA radio group: `role="radiogroup"` (needs `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby`), native radios. Tab enters on the selected radio (or the first); ↓/→ select next, ↑/← select previous (wrapping); Space selects. Disabled radios are skipped.
- Focus ring: 3px `--ui-ring` 45% on the circle (around the card for cards).

#### Acceptance checks
- Arrow keys move focus and selection; only one radio is a tab stop; submits `name=value` in a form.
- Controlled and uncontrolled; `onValueChange` receives the string.
- Card ring is measured to the checked card (same box) and glides on change; no glide on first paint.
- Light, dark, every accent; 390px width (horizontal cards stack).

### `ui/components/radio-group/radio-group.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import {
  createContext,
  forwardRef,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useId,
  useMemo,
  useRef,
  type HTMLAttributes,
  type InputHTMLAttributes,
  type ReactNode,
} from 'react';
import { useControllableState } from '../../hooks/use-controllable-state';
import { useIsomorphicLayoutEffect } from '../../hooks/use-isomorphic-layout-effect';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { useComposedRefs } from '../../lib/compose-refs';

export type RadioGroupOrientation = 'vertical' | 'horizontal';
export type RadioGroupVariant = 'default' | 'card';
export type RadioGroupSize = 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';

interface RadioContextValue {
  name: string;
  value: string;
  setValue: (value: string) => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
  required?: boolean;
  invalid?: boolean;
  variant: RadioGroupVariant;
}

const RadioContext = createContext<RadioContextValue | null>(null);

export interface RadioGroupProps extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'onChange' | 'defaultValue'> {
  /** Selected value (controlled). Use `''` for "nothing selected". */
  value?: string;
  /** Initial value when uncontrolled. */
  defaultValue?: string;
  /** Called with the new value when the selection changes. */
  onValueChange?: (value: string) => void;
  /** Shared `name` of the native radios, so the group submits with a form. Generated if omitted. */
  name?: string;
  /** Layout direction. Default `vertical`. */
  orientation?: RadioGroupOrientation;
  /** `card` renders each item as a bordered card with a selection ring that glides between them. */
  variant?: RadioGroupVariant;
  /** Circle size: 16 / 20 / 24px. Default `md`. */
  size?: RadioGroupSize;
  disabled?: boolean;
  required?: boolean;
  /** Error state for every item. */
  invalid?: boolean;
}

/**
 * RadioGroup — native radios sharing one `name`, so arrow keys, roving
 * tab stop, form submission and screen-reader semantics are the browser's.
 * Controlled or uncontrolled.
 */
export const RadioGroup = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, RadioGroupProps>(function RadioGroup(
  {
    value,
    defaultValue = '',
    onValueChange,
    name,
    orientation = 'vertical',
    variant = 'default',
    size = 'md',
    disabled,
    required,
    invalid,
    className,
    children,
    ...props
  },
  ref,
) {
  const generatedName = useId();
  const [current, setCurrent] = useControllableState({ value, defaultValue, onChange: onValueChange });
  const groupRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const indicatorRef = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
  const composed = useComposedRefs(ref, groupRef);

  const context = useMemo<RadioContextValue>(
    () => ({ name: name ?? generatedName, value: current, setValue: setCurrent, disabled, required, invalid, variant }),
    [name, generatedName, current, setCurrent, disabled, required, invalid, variant],
  );

  // Card variant: measure the selected card and move one ring to it (spring morph via CSS transitions).
  const isCard = variant === 'card';
  const place = useCallback(() => {
    const group = groupRef.current;
    const ring = indicatorRef.current;
    if (!group || !ring) return;
    const item = group.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.ui-radio-card[data-state="checked"]');
    if (!item) {
      ring.style.opacity = '0';
      return;
    }
    ring.style.width = `${item.offsetWidth}px`;
    ring.style.height = `${item.offsetHeight}px`;
    ring.style.transform = `translate(${item.offsetLeft}px, ${item.offsetTop}px)`;
    ring.style.opacity = '1';
  }, []);

  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (isCard) place();
  }, [isCard, current, orientation, place]);

  // The ring may only glide after its first placement, and not while the layout resizes.
  useEffect(() => {
    const group = groupRef.current;
    if (!isCard || !group) return;
    let frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => group.setAttribute('data-glide', ''));
    let first = true;
    const observer =
      typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined'
        ? new ResizeObserver(() => {
            if (first) {
              first = false;
              return;
            }
            group.removeAttribute('data-glide');
            place();
            cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
            frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => group.setAttribute('data-glide', ''));
          })
        : null;
    observer?.observe(group);
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
      observer?.disconnect();
      group.removeAttribute('data-glide');
    };
  }, [isCard, place]);

  return (
    <RadioContext.Provider value={context}>
      <div
        ref={composed}
        role="radiogroup"
        aria-required={required || undefined}
        aria-invalid={invalid || undefined}
        aria-disabled={disabled || undefined}
        data-orientation={orientation}
        data-variant={variant}
        className={cn('ui-radio-group', size !== 'md' && `ui-radio-group-${size}`, className)}
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
        {isCard && <span ref={indicatorRef} className="ui-radio-ring" aria-hidden="true" />}
      </div>
    </RadioContext.Provider>
  );
});

export interface RadioGroupItemProps extends Omit<InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>, 'type' | 'size' | 'value' | 'checked' | 'defaultChecked' | 'name'> {
  /** The value this item represents (required). */
  value: string;
  /** Visible label. Without one, pass `aria-label`. */
  label?: ReactNode;
  /** Secondary text under the label. */
  description?: ReactNode;
  /** Classes for the outer `<label>`; everything else goes to the `<input>`. */
  className?: string;
}

/** One option inside a RadioGroup. */
export const RadioGroupItem = forwardRef<HTMLInputElement, RadioGroupItemProps>(function RadioGroupItem(
  { value, label, description, className, disabled, onChange, 'aria-describedby': describedBy, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const group = useContext(RadioContext);
  if (!group) throw new Error('RadioGroupItem must be rendered inside <RadioGroup>.');
  const descId = useId();
  const checked = group.value === value;
  const isDisabled = disabled || group.disabled;
  const hasText = label != null || description != null;

  return (
    <label
      className={cn('ui-radio', group.variant === 'card' && 'ui-radio-card', className)}
      data-state={checked ? 'checked' : 'unchecked'}
      data-disabled={isDisabled ? '' : undefined}
    >
      <span className="ui-radio-control">
        <input
          ref={ref}
          type="radio"
          className="ui-radio-input"
          name={group.name}
          value={value}
          checked={checked}
          disabled={isDisabled}
          required={group.required}
          aria-invalid={group.invalid || undefined}
          aria-describedby={cn(description != null && descId, describedBy) || undefined}
          onChange={(e) => {
            if (e.currentTarget.checked) group.setValue(value);
            onChange?.(e);
          }}
          {...props}
        />
        <span className="ui-radio-circle" aria-hidden="true">
          <span className="ui-radio-dot" />
        </span>
      </span>
      {hasText && (
        <span className="ui-radio-text">
          {label != null && <span className="ui-radio-label">{label}</span>}
          {description != null && (
            <span id={descId} className="ui-radio-description">
              {description}
            </span>
          )}
        </span>
      )}
    </label>
  );
});
```

### `ui/hooks/use-controllable-state.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';

/**
 * State that can be controlled (`value` + `onChange`) or uncontrolled
 * (`defaultValue`). Every stateful component uses this so the two modes
 * behave identically.
 */
export function useControllableState<T>({
  value,
  defaultValue,
  onChange,
}: {
  value?: T;
  defaultValue: T;
  onChange?: (value: T) => void;
}): [T, (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void] {
  const [internal, setInternal] = useState<T>(defaultValue);
  const controlled = value !== undefined;
  const current = controlled ? (value as T) : internal;
  const currentRef = useRef(current);
  currentRef.current = current;
  const onChangeRef = useRef(onChange);
  onChangeRef.current = onChange;

  const setValue = useCallback(
    (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => {
      const resolved = typeof next === 'function' ? (next as (prev: T) => T)(currentRef.current) : next;
      if (Object.is(resolved, currentRef.current)) return;
      currentRef.current = resolved;
      if (!controlled) setInternal(resolved);
      onChangeRef.current?.(resolved);
    },
    [controlled],
  );

  return [current, setValue];
}
```

'use client';

import { useEffect, useLayoutEffect } from 'react';

/** useLayoutEffect in the browser, useEffect on the server (no SSR warning). */
export const useIsomorphicLayoutEffect = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? useLayoutEffect : useEffect;

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/lib/compose-refs.ts`

```ts
import { useCallback, type Ref, type RefCallback } from 'react';

type PossibleRef<T> = Ref<T> | undefined;

function setRef<T>(ref: PossibleRef<T>, value: T | null) {
  if (typeof ref === 'function') ref(value);
  else if (ref) (ref as { current: T | null }).current = value;
}

/** Merge several refs into one callback ref. */
export function composeRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  return (node) => {
    for (const ref of refs) setRef(ref, node);
  };
}

/** Memoised composeRefs for use inside components. */
export function useComposedRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  return useCallback(composeRefs(...refs), refs);
}
```

### `ui/styles/components/radio-group.css`

```css
/* Radio group -------------------------------------------------------------
   <div class="ui-radio-group [ui-radio-group-sm|-lg]" role="radiogroup" data-orientation data-variant>
     <label class="ui-radio [ui-radio-card]" data-state="checked|unchecked">
       <span class="ui-radio-control"><input class="ui-radio-input" type="radio"> <span class="ui-radio-circle"><span class="ui-radio-dot"></span></span></span>
       <span class="ui-radio-text"><span class="ui-radio-label"> <span class="ui-radio-description">
     </label>
     <span class="ui-radio-ring">   (card variant only: the selection ring that glides between cards)
   The group gets [data-glide] after its first placement; before that the ring never animates.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-radio-group {
    --ui-box: 1.25rem;
    --ui-box-lh: 1.375rem;
    position: relative;
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.75rem;
  }
  .ui-radio-group-sm { --ui-box: 1rem; --ui-box-lh: 1.25rem; }
  .ui-radio-group-lg { --ui-box: 1.5rem; --ui-box-lh: 1.5rem; }
  .ui-radio-group[data-orientation="horizontal"] { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.75rem 1.5rem; }

  .ui-radio {
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 0.625rem;
    width: fit-content;
    font-size: var(--text-base);
    line-height: var(--text-base--line-height);
    color: var(--ui-foreground);
    cursor: pointer;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  }
  .ui-radio-group-sm .ui-radio { font-size: var(--text-sm); line-height: var(--text-sm--line-height); gap: 0.5rem; }
  .ui-radio-group-lg .ui-radio { font-size: var(--text-md); line-height: var(--text-md--line-height); gap: 0.75rem; }

  .ui-radio-control {
    position: relative;
    display: inline-flex;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: var(--ui-box);
    height: var(--ui-box-lh);
  }
  .ui-radio-input {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 1;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    margin: 0;
    opacity: 0;
    cursor: inherit;
    appearance: none;
  }
  .ui-radio-circle {
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    width: var(--ui-box);
    height: var(--ui-box);
    border: 1px solid var(--ui-border-strong);
    border-radius: 9999px;
    background-color: var(--ui-surface);
    box-shadow: var(--ui-shadow-xs);
    pointer-events: none;
    transition:
      background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      border-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      box-shadow var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      transform var(--ui-spring-snappy-duration) var(--ui-spring-snappy);
  }
  .ui-radio-dot {
    width: 40%;
    height: 40%;
    border-radius: 9999px;
    background-color: var(--ui-control-glyph);
    transform: scale(0);
    transition: transform var(--ui-spring-snappy-duration) var(--ui-spring-snappy);
  }

  .ui-radio-input:checked + .ui-radio-circle {
    background-color: var(--ui-control-on);
    border-color: var(--ui-control-on);
    box-shadow: none;
  }
  .ui-radio-input:checked + .ui-radio-circle .ui-radio-dot { transform: scale(1); }
  .ui-radio-input:active:not(:disabled) + .ui-radio-circle { transform: scale(0.92); }
  .ui-radio-input:focus-visible + .ui-radio-circle { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent); }

  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-radio-input:hover:not(:disabled, :checked) + .ui-radio-circle { border-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-foreground) 35%, var(--ui-border-strong)); }
    .ui-radio-input:hover:not(:disabled):checked + .ui-radio-circle { background-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-control-on) 88%, var(--ui-background)); }
  }

  /* Invalid */
  .ui-radio-input[aria-invalid="true"] + .ui-radio-circle { border-color: var(--ui-destructive); }
  .ui-radio-input[aria-invalid="true"]:checked + .ui-radio-circle { background-color: var(--ui-destructive); }
  .ui-radio-input[aria-invalid="true"]:checked + .ui-radio-circle .ui-radio-dot { background-color: var(--ui-destructive-foreground); }
  .ui-radio-input[aria-invalid="true"]:focus-visible + .ui-radio-circle { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-destructive) 35%, transparent); }

  /* Text */
  .ui-radio-text { display: grid; gap: 0.125rem; min-width: 0; user-select: none; }
  .ui-radio-label { font-weight: 500; }
  .ui-radio-description { color: var(--ui-muted-foreground); font-size: var(--text-sm); line-height: var(--text-sm--line-height); }

  /* Disabled */
  .ui-radio[data-disabled] { cursor: not-allowed; }
  .ui-radio[data-disabled] .ui-radio-circle,
  .ui-radio[data-disabled] .ui-radio-text { opacity: 0.5; }
  .ui-radio[data-disabled] .ui-radio-circle { box-shadow: none; }

  /* Cards */
  .ui-radio-group[data-variant="card"] { gap: 0.5rem; }
  .ui-radio-group[data-variant="card"][data-orientation="horizontal"] {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 11rem), 1fr));
    gap: 0.75rem;
  }
  .ui-radio-card {
    width: auto;
    padding: 0.875rem 1rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    background-color: var(--ui-surface);
    transition: background-color var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-standard), border-color var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  .ui-radio-card .ui-radio-text { flex: 1; }
  .ui-radio-card:has(.ui-radio-input:focus-visible) { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent); }
  .ui-radio-card .ui-radio-input:focus-visible + .ui-radio-circle { box-shadow: none; }
  .ui-radio-card[data-disabled] { cursor: not-allowed; }
  .ui-radio-card[data-disabled] .ui-radio-circle,
  .ui-radio-card[data-disabled] .ui-radio-text { opacity: 0.5; }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-radio-card:hover:not([data-disabled], [data-state="checked"]) { background-color: var(--ui-accent); }
  }
  /* Before the ring exists (SSR, first paint) the checked card carries the highlight itself */
  .ui-radio-group:not([data-glide]) .ui-radio-card[data-state="checked"] {
    border-color: var(--ui-control-on);
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--ui-control-on);
  }
  .ui-radio-card[data-state="checked"] { background-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-control-on) 6%, var(--ui-surface)); }

  /* The gliding selection ring: one element measured to the checked card */
  .ui-radio-ring {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 0;
    height: 0;
    border: 1px solid var(--ui-control-on);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--ui-control-on);
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    will-change: transform;
  }
  .ui-radio-group[data-glide] .ui-radio-ring {
    transition:
      transform var(--ui-spring-morph-duration) var(--ui-spring-morph),
      width var(--ui-spring-morph-duration) var(--ui-spring-morph),
      height var(--ui-spring-morph-duration) var(--ui-spring-morph),
      opacity var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
}
```

## Usage

**Delivery speed** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/radio-group/delivery.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
import { RadioGroup, RadioGroupItem } from '@/ui/components/radio-group';

export default function RadioGroupDelivery() {
  return (
    <RadioGroup defaultValue="standard" name="delivery" aria-label="Delivery speed">
      <RadioGroupItem value="standard" label="Standard" description="3–5 business days. Free over $50." />
      <RadioGroupItem value="express" label="Express" description="1–2 business days. $9.00." />
      <RadioGroupItem value="overnight" label="Overnight" description="Tomorrow by 10 am. $24.00." />
      <RadioGroupItem value="pickup" label="Pick up in store" description="Not available for this address." disabled />
    </RadioGroup>
  );
}
```
